# CANDIDATE: TASK_SCOUTER_MULTILINE_PAREN_TEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are adding a test to prevent silent drops in the task queue by ensuring that any open item (- [ ]) with an open parenthesis on the same line also has a closing parenthesis. This prevents the task_scorer from misparsing and dropping tasks.

## Mechanism

The test will scan `queue.md` for lines matching the pattern '^- \[ \]\s+\S+\s+\(' (an open item followed by a non-whitespace and then an open parenthesis) and verify that the same physical line contains a closing ')'. If any such line lacks a closing parenthesis, the test fails.
